sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: The woman accusing Judge Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault now says she wants an FBI investigation into her claiMs. What that means for the confirmation process.
sentences.zh: 指控布雷特·卡瓦诺法官性侵的那位女性现在表示，她希望联邦调查局（FBI）对她的指控进行调查。这对确认程序意味着什么。

sentences.en: Wednesday, September 19th.
sentences.zh: 9月19日，星期三。

sentences.en: As we come on the air in the West, we do have breaking news involving President Trump's embattled Supreme Court nominee.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始在西部地区播出时，我们确实有关于特朗普总统陷入困境的最高法院提名人的突发新闻。

sentences.en: Peter, it's Tuesday evening, and we have yet another development in this story.
sentences.zh: 彼得，现在是周二晚上，这个故事又有了新的进展。

sentences.en: What is going on?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Breaking news just in the last few minutes.
sentences.zh: 就在过去几分钟内传来的突发新闻。

sentences.en: New tonight, a letter from the accuser.
sentences.zh: 今晚最新消息，一封来自指控者的信。

sentences.en: Letter that her attorneys have just moments ago sent to committee chairman
sentences.zh: 她的律师刚刚将这封信发送给了委员会主席

sentences.en: Chuck Grassley.
sentences.zh: 查克·格拉斯利。

sentences.en: Well, at this point, the climactic hearing that everybody expected for next Monday
sentences.zh: 好吧，目前来看，大家原本期待下周一举行的那场高潮迭起的听证会，

sentences.en: that would pit Judge Kavanaugh against his accuser, Christine Blasey Ford, now looks like it may or may not happen.
sentences.zh: 即卡瓦诺法官与指控者克里斯汀·布莱西·福特对质的听证会，现在看来可能举行，也可能不会举行。

sentences.en: We're not sure.
sentences.zh: 我们还不确定。

sentences.en: Peter Baker covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 彼得·贝克为《时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: Dr. Blasey, university professor from California, has said that she wants to have her allegations investigated first by the FBI.
sentences.zh: 来自加州的大学教授布莱西博士表示，她希望先由FBI调查她的指控。

sentences.en: And this is the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 这就是核心所在。

sentences.en: And I'm quoting, as the Judiciary Committee has recognized and done before, an FBI investigation of the incident should be the first step in addressing her allegations.
sentences.zh: 我引用一下，正如司法委员会之前所承认并做过的那样，对该事件进行FBI调查应该是处理她指控的第一步。

sentences.en: That, of course, even if it was granted as a request, couldn't happen probably before Monday.
sentences.zh: 当然，即使这个请求被批准，恐怕在周一之前也无法完成。

sentences.en: And so the question is, at this point, where we go from here.
sentences.zh: 所以现在的问题是，接下来我们该怎么办。

sentences.en: Nobody knows for sure.
sentences.zh: 没人能确定。

sentences.en: A full investigation by law enforcement officials will ensure that the crucial facts and witnesses
sentences.zh: 执法官员进行的全面调查将确保这一事件中的关键事实和证人

sentences.en: in this matter are assessed in a nonpartisan manner and that the committee is fully informed before conducting any hearings or making any decisions.
sentences.zh: 以无党派的方式进行评估，并确保委员会在举行任何听证会或做出任何决定之前得到充分的信息。

sentences.en: She doesn't explicitly say she wouldn't appear before the committee if there's not an FBI investigation, but that's sort of the import you take from what she's saying.
sentences.zh: 她并没有明确表示如果没有FBI调查她就不会出席委员会听证会，但从她的话中可以得出这样的推论。

sentences.en: You're saying your client will not sit down Monday for a public hearing.
sentences.zh: 你是说你的当事人周一不会参加公开听证会。

sentences.en: There's no reason that we should have a public hearing on Monday, given what has occurred and when it has occurred.
sentences.zh: 鉴于已经发生的事情以及发生的时间，我们没有理由在周一举行公开听证会。

sentences.en: Asking her to come forward in four or five days and sit before the Judiciary Committee on national TV is not a fair process.
sentences.zh: 要求她在四五天内站出来，在全国电视直播中面对司法委员会，这并不是一个公平的程序。

sentences.en: So, Peter, why were we reporting on Monday and much of Tuesday that this hearing was going ahead for next week with both Kavanaugh and Dr. Blasey testifying?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，为什么我们周一和周二大部分时间都在报道说下周的听证会将如期举行，卡瓦诺和布莱西博士都将作证？

sentences.en: Well, remember, yesterday, her lawyer said that she wanted to testify and she would agree to if she was asked.
sentences.zh: 嗯，记住，昨天她的律师说她想作证，如果被要求，她会同意。

sentences.en: And then Senate Republicans who didn't want her to testify, didn't want anybody
sentences.zh: 然后，那些不想让她作证、不想让任何人

sentences.en: to testify, relented by the end of the day, said, fine, we'll have a hearing and we'll have it Monday.
sentences.zh: 作证的参议院共和党人在一天结束时让步了，说好吧，我们会举行听证会，就在周一。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的收听。

sentences.en: Pleased to welcome back now the Senate Judiciary Committee Chairman
sentences.zh: 现在很高兴欢迎参议院司法委员会主席

sentences.en: Chuck Grassley of Iowa.
sentences.zh: 来自爱荷华州的查克·格拉斯利。

sentences.en: Let's get right to it.
sentences.zh: 我们直接进入正题。

sentences.en: Will the hearing on Monday be televised?
sentences.zh: 周一的听证会会进行电视转播吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think everybody then took that the next step and assumed, well, she said she wanted to testify and they've now agreed to have a hearing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为大家随后都采取了下一步行动，并假设，好吧，她说她想作证，他们现在也同意举行听证会了。

sentences.en: This must be happening.
sentences.zh: 这事肯定会发生。

sentences.en: Has Dr. Ford accepted and she has agreed to come?
sentences.zh: 福特博士接受了吗？她同意来了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: She didn't actually communicate a yes to this specific date, this specific time.
sentences.zh: 她实际上并没有对这个特定的日期和时间给出肯定的答复。

sentences.en: We have reached out to her in the last 36 hours, three or four times by email, and we've not heard from them.
sentences.zh: 在过去的36小时里，我们通过电子邮件联系了她三四次，但没有收到他们的回复。

sentences.en: So it kind of raises the question, do they want to come to the public hearing or not?
sentences.zh: 所以这引发了一个问题：他们到底想不想来参加公开听证会？

sentences.en: So, you know, we're in a situation here where in some ways she asked to have a chance to testify,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们现在的处境是，在某种程度上她要求有机会作证，

sentences.en: but she doesn't like the circumstances under which they are creating that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 但她不喜欢他们创造这个机会的环境。

sentences.en: So we made an assumption, it seems safe, and now it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做了一个假设，看起来很稳妥，但现在看来并非如此。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, you know, the chairman of the committee said he's got to hold a hearing and he could subpoena her if he wanted to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，你知道，委员会主席说他必须举行听证会，如果他愿意，他可以传唤她。

sentences.en: And the chairman of the committee says he's got to hold a hearing.
sentences.zh: 而且委员会主席说他必须举行听证会。

sentences.en: You assume he's got to hold a hearing.
sentences.zh: 你假设他必须举行听证会。

sentences.en: It's pretty unusual to have a witness say, yeah, I'm not so comfortable with that.
sentences.zh: 让证人说“是的，我对那个不太舒服”是相当不寻常的。

sentences.en: Now, mind you, she hasn't said yet she won't come on
sentences.zh: 现在，请注意，她还没有说她周一不会来。

sentences.en: Monday.
sentences.zh: 她说的是她认为FBI应该先进行调查。目前还不清楚那种调查会是什么样子。

sentences.en: What she said is she thinks the FBI should investigate firSt. It's not clear what that kind of investigation would look like.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这里没有联邦犯罪。

sentences.en: There's not a federal crime here that we know of.
sentences.zh: 指控内容是性侵，这属于州法律管辖范围。

sentences.en: The allegation would be sexual assault, which would be under state statute.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，那是30多年前的事了。

sentences.en: And of course, it would be 30 some years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以问题就在于，即使委员会要求，FBI能否进行调查？

sentences.en: So the question then would be, could the FBI investigate anyway because the committee asked them to?
sentences.zh: 我想如果地区委员会主席要求

sentences.en: I presume if the chairman of the district committee asked the
sentences.zh: FBI进行调查或重新开启对提名人的背景调查，他们大概是可以做到的，但他们实际上能做什么来澄清这件事，我并不清楚。

sentences.en: FBI to investigate or to reopen the background check for a nominee that they presumably could do so, what they could actually do to clear this up is unclear to me.
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 嗯，证人很少。

sentences.en: Well, there are very few people witnesses.
sentences.zh: 没有法医证据。

sentences.en: There's no forensic evidence.
sentences.zh: 我认为，要确凿地证明这件事发生过或没发生过，将是一件非常、非常困难的事情。

sentences.en: It would be a hard, hard thing, I think, to prove dispositively yes or no, that it did happen or didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 所以他们能做的可能是提供更多的细节、更多的信息、更多的背景，这可能有助于参议员们做出判断。

sentences.en: And so what they might be able to do is provide more details, more information, more context that might help senators come to some judgment.
sentences.zh: 但我的猜测是，这不会是那种无论哪种结果都具有100%说服力的证据。

sentences.en: But my guess is it would not be the kind of proof that would be 100% persuasive either way.
sentences.zh: 关于FBI调查的另一件事是，根据你的结构安排，它可能会持续很长时间。

sentences.en: The other thing about an FBI investigation is it can go on for an awfully long time, depending on how you structure it.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个重要的因素。

sentences.en: And that may be an important factor here.
sentences.zh: 这需要花费数周时间。

sentences.en: It's the kind of thing that would take weeks.
sentences.zh: 会花费数月吗？

sentences.en: Would it take months?
sentences.zh: 这会把事情推迟到选举之后吗？

sentences.en: Is it something that would push it past the election?
sentences.zh: 这是参议员们会敏锐意识到的事情。

sentences.en: That's something that the senators are going to be acutely aware of.
sentences.zh: 所以无论是有意还是无意，布莱西博士希望FBI先调查这件事，这对民主党人来说是好消息，对共和党人来说是坏消息。

sentences.en: So inadvertently or not, Dr. Blasey's desire to have the FBI investigate this first is good news for Democrats, bad news for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这与民主党人一直在说的话相吻合，至于这是好消息还是坏消息，我不知道。

sentences.en: Well, it lines up with what the Democrats have been saying, whether it's good news or bad news, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 格拉斯利主席必须推迟投票。

sentences.en: Chairman Grassley must postpone the vote.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在共和党人同意举行这次听证会后，说，等一下，你们现在只是在仓促行事。

sentences.en: The Democrats, having gotten this hearing agreed to by the Republicans, are saying, well, wait a second, you're just rushing it at this point.
sentences.zh: 面对如此严重的指控，参议院绝不能、也不可以对福特博士的指控进行草率、马虎的审查，也不能仓促投票。

sentences.en: With allegations as serious as the ones before us, the Senate must not, it cannot, conduct a haphazard slipshod review of Dr. Ford's claims or be rushed to a vote.
sentences.zh: 怎么能在短短几天内举行听证会，而不做任何调查研究或尽职调查呢？

sentences.en: How can you have a hearing in just a few days without doing any kind of research for investigation, due diligence?
sentences.zh: 你们只是想尽快结束这件事，好让你们能仓促投票。

sentences.en: You're just trying to get this over with quickly so you can rush a vote.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能重蹈安妮塔·希尔听证会的覆辙。

sentences.en: We must not repeat the mistake of the Anita Hill hearings.
sentences.zh: 那次听证会太仓促，简直是一场灾难。

sentences.en: They were rushed and were a debacle.
sentences.zh: 我们想重蹈覆辙吗？

sentences.en: Do we want to repeat that mistake?
sentences.zh: 所以她的立场，无论她是否有意，都与民主党人在此事上的立场一致。

sentences.en: So her position, whether she intends it or not, is in line with where the Democrats have been coming out on this.
sentences.zh: 周一会有两名证人吗？

sentences.en: And will there only be two witnesses on Monday?
sentences.zh: 呃，是的。

sentences.en: Uh, yes.
sentences.zh: 共和党人对这次听证会的描述并不是那种带入大量证人的全面调查。

sentences.en: And what Republicans have been describing about this hearing was not a full-fledged kind of investigation where they brought in lots of witnesses.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎旨在听取卡瓦诺法官和他的指控者布莱西博士的陈述，实际上是制造了一个“公说公有理，婆说婆有理”的局面。

sentences.en: What they seem to be aiming for was hearing from Judge Kavanaugh and hearing from his accuser, Dr. Blasey, in effect, setting up a he said, she said scenario.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这引发了关于他们是否试图尽快摆脱指控的问题，因为我们距离这次听证会后仅有六周时间就要进行选举了。

sentences.en: But obviously that raises questions about whether they're trying to move past allegations as quickly as possible, because we're facing an election in just six
sentences.zh: 在现代，你从未在如此接近中期选举的时候遇到过如此爆炸性的确认听证会。

sentences.en: weeks from after this hearing.
sentences.zh: 没人知道这会如何影响竞选。

sentences.en: And you've not had such an explosive kind of confirmation hearing so close to a midterm election in modern times.
sentences.zh: 没人知道他们是否真的能在选举前通过这项提名。

sentences.en: And nobody knows how that's going to affect the campaign.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不能在选举前通过，很有可能民主党人会在一月份控制参议院，那将是全新的局面。

sentences.en: Nobody knows whether, in fact, they could get this nomination through before the election.
sentences.zh: 有没有可能在没有布莱西博士的情况下继续进行听证会？

sentences.en: If they can't get it through before the election, it's very possible that the Democrats might control the Senate come January, and then it's a whole new ballgame.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不知道他们今天是否谈过这个，但我可以看到这种情况发生，只是为了给他一个公开反驳指控的机会。

sentences.en: And is there a version of this where the hearings move ahead without Dr. Blasey?
sentences.zh: 在他看来，是为了洗清自己的名声。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know if they've spoken about that today, but I could see that happening just to give him a chance to publicly refute the allegations.
sentences.zh: 共和党人大概会抓住这一点说，你看，她站出来对他提出了指控，但当我们给她机会讲述她的故事时，她却不露面。

sentences.en: And in his view, clear his name.
sentences.zh: 那将使他的话成为人们唯一能看到的电视记录。

sentences.en: The Republicans would presumably take this and say, well, see, she came forward and lodged this complaint against him, but then wouldn't show up when we gave her an opportunity
sentences.zh: 这可能会产生不同的影响。

sentences.en: to tell her story.
sentences.zh: 这可能会让选民看到这一点并说，好吧，我听了他的话，但我没有听到任何人有说服力地反驳他。

sentences.en: And that would leave his as the only, you know, sort of televised word on the record that people could see.
sentences.zh: 或者情况可能恰恰相反。

sentences.en: That could play different ways.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们是在强迫她。

sentences.en: That could play in the way of voters looking at that saying, OK, I've heard him and I don't hear anybody persuasively countering him.
sentences.zh: 所以双方真的都没有掌握处理这件事的最佳方式，无论是实质上还是政治上。

sentences.en: Or it could play the other way around.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，很难想象只听卡瓦诺的陈述而不听布莱西博士的。

sentences.en: It looks like they're giving her the bums rush.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这能满足那些温和派共和党人和民主党人吗？他们曾表示在弄清真相之前，他们对投票感到不舒服。

sentences.en: So both sides really don't have a firm hold on what the best way to handle this is, either substantively or politically.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于白宫来说，目前没有民主党人会参与其中。

sentences.en: It's kind of hard for me to imagine just hearing from Kavanaugh and not from Dr. Blasey.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是共和党人，以及他们是否能保住他们的51票。

sentences.en: I mean, would that satisfy the moderate Republicans and the Democrats who have said that they are not comfortable voting on this until they can get to
sentences.zh: 有四五位共和党人被认为是潜在的摇摆选民，特别是来自缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯、来自阿拉斯加的丽莎·穆尔科斯基、来自亚利桑那州的杰夫·弗莱克、来自田纳西州的鲍勃·科克。

sentences.en: the bottom of this accusation?
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道在没有她的情况下进行听证会是否能满足他们。

sentences.en: I think for the White House at this point, there are no Democrats in play.
sentences.zh: 但当然，你知道，如果他们想投票支持他，并且想找个理由说，好吧，我们给了她机会，而她没有利用它，他们大概可以这么说。

sentences.en: The only question is the Republicans and whether or not they can hold their 51 votes.
sentences.zh: 但这真的取决于他们认为什么是最好的前进方式。

sentences.en: There are four or five
sentences.zh: 所以假设这次听证会继续进行，可能只是推迟了几天或几周。

sentences.en: Republicans who are thought to be potential swing voters, including particularly Susan Collins of
sentences.zh: 据我了解，你一直在报道白宫是如何准备和思考这些听证会的。

sentences.en: Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, Jeff Flake of Arizona, Bob Corker of Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 你从这些报道中学到了什么？

sentences.en: So we don't know whether or not a hearing proceeding without her would satisfy them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为你将看到的辩护，也就是似乎正在形成的辩护，是关于身份认同错误的情况，他们不会直接攻击布莱西博士和她的信誉。

sentences.en: But it would certainly, you know, if they wanted to vote for him and they wanted to find a reason to say, well, we gave her a chance
sentences.zh: 他们不会说这没有发生。

sentences.en: and she didn't take advantage of it, they could presumably say that.
sentences.zh: 他们要说的是卡瓦诺法官没有做这件事。

sentences.en: But it's really going to come down to what they think is the best way forward here.
sentences.zh: 所以如果她遭受了这种可怕的折磨，如果她像她描述的那样被侵犯了，那一定是别人干的。

sentences.en: So let's say that this hearing moves ahead, just maybe delayed by a few days, by a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 现在，这对许多人来说可能没有说服力，但卡瓦诺法官在否认时没有留下任何回旋余地。

sentences.en: My understanding is that you have been reporting on how the White House is preparing for and thinking about these hearings.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果不是他说的那样，也不是她说的那样，唯一的可能性就是其中存在某种混淆。

sentences.en: And what have you learned from that reporting?
sentences.zh: 所以我今天在电话里和他谈过。

sentences.en: Well, I think that the defense that you're going to see, the one that seems to be emerging,
sentences.zh: 他对你说了什么？

sentences.en: is that it's a case of mistaken identity, that they're not going to attack Dr. Blasey and her credibility in a direct way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他没做过那件事。

sentences.en: They're not going to say this didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 而且他当时不在那个聚会上。

sentences.en: What they're going to say is that Judge Kavanaugh didn't do this.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，显然有人搞错了。

sentences.en: And so if she was subjected to this terrible ordeal, if she was assaulted the way she describes it, it must have been somebody else.
sentences.zh: 你昨天听到了哈奇参议员谈论这件事。

sentences.en: Now, that may not be persuasive to many people, but Judge Kavanaugh has left no wiggle room in his denial.
sentences.zh: 你相信他吗？

sentences.en: And therefore, if it's not what he says or she says, the only other possibility is that there's some confusion there.
sentences.zh: 是的，我当然相信。

sentences.en: So I talked to him on the phone today.
sentences.zh: 你相信指控者吗？

sentences.en: And what did he say to you?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, he didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为她弄错了。

sentences.en: And he wasn't at the party.
sentences.zh: 我认为她，她把什么事情弄错了。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's clearly somebody's mixed up.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，显然有人搞错了。

sentences.en: You heard Senator Hatch talk about this yesterday.
sentences.zh: 你昨天听到了哈奇参议员谈论这件事。

sentences.en: And you believe him?
sentences.zh: 你相信他吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I sure do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我当然相信。

sentences.en: Do you believe the accusers?
sentences.zh: 你相信那些指控者吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.

sentences.en: Well, I think she's mistaken.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为她弄错了。

sentences.en: I think she's, she's mistaken something.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她，她把什么东西搞错了。

sentences.en: After speaking to Judge Kavanaugh, he says, I think she was mixed up.
sentences.zh: 在与卡瓦诺法官交谈后，他说，我认为她搞混了。

sentences.en: She was confused with somebody else, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 或许她把别人认成他了。

sentences.en: Well, I couldn't believe it when I heard she was accusing Brett of this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我听说她指控布雷特这件事时，我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: And I immediately knew we had to rally around and support him because that was not the Brett Kavanaugh we knew.
sentences.zh: 我立刻意识到我们必须团结起来支持他，因为那根本不是我们所认识的布雷特·卡瓦诺。

sentences.en: Some of Judge Kavanaugh's friends have raised that.
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺法官的一些朋友也提出了这一点。

sentences.en: Hopefully, the woman will come forward, state her case.
sentences.zh: 希望这位女士能站出来，陈述她的情况。

sentences.en: He will state his case.
sentences.zh: 他也会陈述他的情况。

sentences.en: And you see that President Trump is not going after Dr. Blasey directly saying that she shouldn't be believed.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到特朗普总统并没有直接针对布莱西博士，说她不值得相信。

sentences.en: In fact, he's saying she should be heard.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他说应该听听她的说法。

sentences.en: They will look at what she had to say from 36 years ago.
sentences.zh: 他们会审视她对36年前发生的事情的陈述。

sentences.en: And we will see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It sounds like the strategy of mistaken identity, of questioning whether or not she remembers the right person doing these alleged things to her, is a result of really two factors.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是“认错人”的策略，即质疑她是否记错了对她做出这些所谓行为的人，这实际上是两个因素的结果。

sentences.en: Judge Kavanaugh's categorical denial and the fact that we are in a moment where trying to
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺法官断然否认，以及我们正处于这样一个时刻：试图

sentences.en: challenge a woman's story of sexual harassment, of questioning its credibility, is very perilous.
sentences.zh: 挑战一位女性关于性骚扰的陈述，质疑其可信度，是非常危险的。

sentences.en: Well, that's right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实如此。

sentences.en: So in that atmosphere, it would be a political big risk to attack her credibility and say she was making this up.
sentences.zh: 因此在那种氛围下，攻击她的可信度并说她在编造故事，将是一个巨大的政治风险。

sentences.en: So if they can't do that, and if Judge Kavanaugh insists nothing of the sort happened, nothing even that was misconstrued or any kind of, you
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们不能那样做，而且如果卡瓦诺法官坚持认为根本没有发生过那种事，甚至连被误解的、或者任何形式的，你知道，

sentences.en: know, different version of the same event, which is one possibility, except that he's now ruled that out.
sentences.zh: 同一事件的不同版本都没有发生过——这本是一种可能性，但他现在已经排除了这一点。

sentences.en: Since that is the case, this idea of mistaken identity is both as a matter of the substance and as a matter of the, you know, the strategy, the place where they seem
sentences.zh: 既然如此，这种“认错人”的想法，无论是从实质内容上，还是从，你知道，策略上来看，似乎都是他们

sentences.en: to be coming around.
sentences.zh: 正在转向的方向。

sentences.en: So you can imagine a series of questions that respectfully engage Dr. Blasey, say, we know something happened to you.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象一系列的问题，以尊重的态度与布莱西博士接触，说，我们知道你身上发生了一些事。

sentences.en: We just think it was somebody else.
sentences.zh: 我们只是认为那是别人做的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: In other words, they're able to convey a certain level of sympathy and humanity, but challenge the face and the identity of the accused.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们能够传达出一定程度的同情和人性，但同时挑战被指控者的面孔和身份。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个想法。

sentences.en: Now, of course, that could easily backfire too.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也很容易适得其反。

sentences.en: You know, it could come across as insulting or she could be insulted, feel offended, that they would question her remembering this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能会被认为是一种侮辱，或者她可能会感到被冒犯，因为他们质疑她对这件事的记忆。

sentences.en: You can certainly imagine that somebody who's undergone this kind of an ordeal would say, I certainly know who I was pinned down on that bed with, and
sentences.zh: 你当然可以想象，一个经历过这种折磨的人会说，我当然知道是谁把我按在床上，

sentences.en: that that could backfire in a big way too.
sentences.zh: 而这可能会产生巨大的反作用。

sentences.en: So this is such a volatile and uncertain moment that nobody knows how this would play out, especially if it does get to a hearing with
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个如此动荡和不确定的时刻，没人知道事态会如何发展，尤其是如果这件事真的进入了听证会，

sentences.en: the two of them in front of the Senate Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: 他们两人出现在参议院司法委员会面前。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Even this strategy seems like a tough line to walk in this moment.
sentences.zh: 即使是这种策略，在当下似乎也是一条难走的钢丝。

sentences.en: We believe the woman, but not entirely.
sentences.zh: 我们相信这位女士，但不是完全相信。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Again, as a matter of strategy, what they need to do is hold on to these Republicans who might waver.
sentences.zh: 同样，作为一种策略，他们需要稳住那些可能会动摇的共和党人。

sentences.en: And if the Republicans find that there's an alternative to her version of events, her account, then it's possible they might still vote for him because they
sentences.zh: 如果共和党人发现对她的事件版本、她的陈述还有另一种解释，那么他们仍有可能投票支持他，因为他们

sentences.en: would say, well, this is a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 会说，嗯，那是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: We can't be proven.
sentences.zh: 我们无法证实。

sentences.en: Maybe she had somebody else in mind.
sentences.zh: 也许她记错人了。

sentences.en: We shouldn't make assumptions that he did this if absent more evidence.
sentences.zh: 在缺乏更多证据的情况下，我们不应假设是他做的。

sentences.en: But again, it could play both ways.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，这可能会产生双重影响。

sentences.en: And I think that the moment is so fraught, this issue is so hot, and the consequences are so large that it could still play out in many, many different ways.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在的时刻如此紧张，这个问题如此敏感，后果如此严重，以至于事态仍可能以多种不同的方式发展。

sentences.en: There's no question that things have changed enough in this moment that the strategy for how
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，现在的情况已经发生了足够大的变化，以至于处理布莱西博士指控的策略

sentences.en: to deal with this allegation from Dr. Blasey is different because Republicans can't handle it the way that they handled the allegations from Anita Hill.
sentences.zh: 变得不同了，因为共和党人无法像处理安妮塔·希尔的指控那样处理这件事。

sentences.en: They can't ignore it.
sentences.zh: 他们不能无视它。

sentences.en: They can't crush the character of the woman making the allegation, Dr. Blasey.
sentences.zh: 他们不能摧毁提出指控的女性——布莱西博士的人格。

sentences.en: But I guess I'm wondering if things have changed in a more meaningful way, such that Republicans are genuinely concerned that these
sentences.zh: 但我猜我在想，情况是否发生了更深远的改变，以至于共和党人真的担心这些

sentences.en: allegations are true and that if they are true, that it would be very concerning to them that their vote would be in question, that they might oppose him.
sentences.zh: 指控是真的，如果属实，他们会非常担心自己的投票会受到质疑，他们可能会反对他。

sentences.en: Or are they just looking for the strategy that in this moment gets their nominee through, gets Judge Kavanaugh on the Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 还是他们只是在寻找一种策略，能在当下让他们的提名人通过，让卡瓦诺法官进入最高法院？

sentences.en: It's very easy to look at Washington through a cynical lens because, in fact, Washington acts so cynically all the time.
sentences.zh: 用愤世嫉俗的眼光看待华盛顿非常容易，因为事实上，华盛顿一直表现得如此愤世嫉俗。

sentences.en: Things that are so personal and so traumatic, as what we're talking about here, are filtered through the lens of partisan politics.
sentences.zh: 像我们在这里讨论的这样私密且具有创伤性的事情，都被党派政治的滤镜过滤了。

sentences.en: Who's up?
sentences.zh: 谁占上风？

sentences.en: Who's down?
sentences.zh: 谁处于下风？

sentences.en: Who's going to win?
sentences.zh: 谁会赢？

sentences.en: Who's going to lose?
sentences.zh: 谁会输？

sentences.en: How do you get what you want?
sentences.zh: 你如何得到你想要的？

sentences.en: And what you want is to get him on the court or keep him from getting on the court.
sentences.zh: 而你想要的是让他进入法院，或者阻止他进入法院。

sentences.en: And in the process, very real human beings are caught up in this and they will be scarred forever.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，真正的人被卷入其中，他们将永远留下伤痕。

sentences.en: I think at the same time, people in politics in Washington, you know, at least many of them, have a human side too.
sentences.zh: 我认为与此同时，华盛顿的政治人物，你知道，至少他们中的许多人，也有人性的一面。

sentences.en: And they do actually want to know what happened.
sentences.zh: 他们确实想知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And they do find these allegations troubling.
sentences.zh: 他们确实觉得这些指控令人不安。

sentences.en: And they do worry about putting somebody on the Supreme Court who is honorable and who is not the kind of person that has been described in these allegations.
sentences.zh: 他们确实担心让一个不是正直的人、不是这些指控中所描述的那种人进入最高法院。

sentences.en: But there's no question that politics is the name of the game here.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，政治才是这里的核心游戏。

sentences.en: And that in the end, you know, it's hard for people in the middle of the arena to escape that and to not have that at least factor into their calculations.
sentences.zh: 最终，你知道，身处竞技场中心的人很难逃脱这一点，也很难不把这一点纳入他们的考量。

sentences.en: I was so struck by the quote from the friends of Dr. Blasey saying, this is her worst nightmare.
sentences.zh: 布莱西博士的朋友们说这是她最可怕的噩梦，这句话让我深受触动。

sentences.en: And I thought to myself, this is probably his worst nightmare too.
sentences.zh: 我心想，这可能也是他最可怕的噩梦。

sentences.en: Well, I think it really is both of them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这确实对他们两人都是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, here's the thing, you know, like I was talking to some friends of his, like, and they're mixed, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事情是这样的，你知道，就像我和他的一些朋友交谈时，他们态度不一，对吧？

sentences.en: So friends of his, like there are some who are very upset on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 所以他的朋友们，有些人为他感到非常难过。

sentences.en: They think, you know, he's got a wife, he's got two kids and look what he's going through.
sentences.zh: 他们想，你知道，他有妻子，有两个孩子，看看他正在经历什么。

sentences.en: Look how his name has been brought through the mud.
sentences.zh: 看看他的名声是如何被抹黑的。

sentences.en: And their view is even if he did something terrible a long time ago, when you're drunk, you're 17, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 他们的观点是，即使他在很久以前喝醉时做了什么可怕的事，那时他才17岁，等等等等。

sentences.en: He's been an exemplary life ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后他一直过着模范的生活。

sentences.en: That would be their point.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的观点。

sentences.en: But I've also talked to friends who say, look, I really hope this is not true because this is so inconsistent with the guy I know.
sentences.zh: 但我也和一些朋友谈过，他们说，看，我真的希望这不是真的，因为这和我认识的那个人太不一致了。

sentences.en: And I would be terribly disturbed to learn that he could do this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 如果得知他能做出这种事，我会感到非常不安。

sentences.en: And even his friends say, look, why on earth would she come forward if she wasn't telling the truth?
sentences.zh: 甚至他的朋友们也说，看，如果她不是在说真话，她为什么要站出来？

sentences.en: What would be her motive for doing it?
sentences.zh: 她这么做的动机是什么？

sentences.en: She has less to gain by making a false assertion than he has to gain by making a false denial, right?
sentences.zh: 她做出虚假陈述所能获得的利益，远小于他做出虚假否认所能获得的利益，对吧？

sentences.en: And so everybody, I think, is wrestling with these things, even the people who are close to the participants and trying to sort out, you know, conflicting truths
sentences.zh: 所以我认为每个人都在与这些事情作斗争，即使是那些与当事人关系密切的人，也在试图理清，你知道，相互冲突的真相

sentences.en: and conflicting feelings.
sentences.zh: 和相互冲突的感受。

sentences.en: Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 彼得，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 哦，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, in response to the request from Dr. Blassie's lawyer, the chairman of the Judiciary Committee,
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，针对布莱西博士律师提出的要求，司法委员会主席

sentences.en: Chuck Grassley, said that no FBI investigation of Judge Kavanaugh was warranted and that the invitation for Dr. Blassie to testify on Monday still stands.
sentences.zh: 查克·格拉斯利表示，没有理由对卡瓦诺法官进行联邦调查局调查，布莱西博士周一作证的邀请仍然有效。

sentences.en: Earlier in the day, during a news conference at the White House, President Trump had expressed sympathy for Judge Kavanaugh's situation.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，在白宫举行的新闻发布会上，特朗普总统对卡瓦诺法官的处境表示了同情。

sentences.en: I feel so badly for him that he's going through this, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 老实说，他正在经历这些，我为他感到非常难过。

sentences.en: I feel so badly for him.
sentences.zh: 我为他感到非常难过。

sentences.en: This is not a man that deserves this.
sentences.zh: 他不是一个应该遭受这种待遇的人。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Times reports that because of a growing number of death threats, Dr. Blassie has moved out of her house, is arranging for private
sentences.zh: 与此同时，《泰晤士报》报道称，由于越来越多的死亡威胁，布莱西博士已经搬离了她的住所，正在为她的家人安排私人

sentences.en: security for her family, and is effectively in hiding.
sentences.zh: 安保，实际上处于躲藏状态。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《泰晤士报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《泰晤士报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《泰晤士报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《泰晤士报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, in the latest chapter of a tit-for-tat trade war, China said it would impose tariffs on $60 billion of U.S.
sentences.zh: 周二，在一场针锋相对的贸易战的最新篇章中，中国表示将对600亿美元的美国

sentences.en: goods, taxing nearly everything China buys from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 商品征收关税，几乎涵盖了中国从美国购买的所有商品。

sentences.en: The move was retaliation for new U.S.
sentences.zh: 此举是对美国新一轮

sentences.en: tariffs on $200 billion of
sentences.zh: 对2000亿美元

sentences.en: Chinese goods.
sentences.zh: 中国商品征收关税的报复。

sentences.en: Tariffs President Trump praised on Tuesday at the White House.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统周二在白宫称赞了这些关税。

sentences.en: And the way I look at it, last year, we lost over $500 billion to China.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，去年我们对中国损失了超过5000亿美元。
